root_cause.text: The s390 BPF JIT compiler violated the s390x ABI by failing to zero-extend unsigned arguments and return values because the register extension logic omitted zero-extension instructions when the signed flag was unset.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies the `sign_extend` function in `arch/s390/net/bpf_jit_comp.c` to emit zero-extension opcodes (e.g., `llgcr`, `llghr`, `llgfr`) when the `BTF_FMODEL_SIGNED_ARG` flag is not set, correcting the previous implementation which returned early without performing any extension for unsigned types.

intent_record.how: Ensures unsigned arguments are explicitly zero-extended to 64-bit width during JIT compilation, correcting prior behavior where they were left unextended.
